result.title: Scaling Looped MoE Language Models under Matched Budgets: Information Flow and Parameter Allocation
result.summary: Looped Transformers decouple computational depth from parameter count, and prior studies have demonstrated promising performance gains with increased computation. However, systematic design principles for configuring these models under strict iso-parameter and iso-FLOP constraints remain scarce. We contribute to this direction by improving information flow in looped models and systematically studying loop parameter configurations. Specifically, we refine this information flow via gated inner-loop state updates and a cross-stage residual connection. Building on this design, controlled studies identify a configuration combining a single-pass Core depth of 25%-35% of the total unrolled depth with reallocating saved parameters into extra routed experts per layer, improving performance at zero extra compute while preserving compatibility with existing training infrastructure. Evaluated after 1T pre-training tokens, our 69B MLA and 51B KDA Mixture-of-Experts models outperform budget-matched non-recurrent baselines by an average of 1.16 and 2.29 percentage points across four benchmarks, respectively. Further reproduction experiments on a common backbone with a 200B-token training budget show that our method achieves lower perplexity than other looped methods. Code for these reproduction experiments is available at https://github.com/lxi01766/Scaling-Looped-MoE-Language-Models-under-Matched-Budgets-Information-Flow-and-Parameter-Allocation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在等参数、等 FLOP 约束下研究 looped MoE 语言模型的配置，通过门控内循环状态更新和跨阶段残差改善信息流，并在消融中考察循环深度与专家参数分配的组合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其门控循环状态更新、跨阶段残差及计算深度与参数预算的权衡，可能为 LVR 中循环式潜在状态更新和动态计算配置提供可核查线索，但属于纯文本预训练方法，需判断能否迁移到多模态推理。
